title: Security
description: Manage security settings, permissions, and audit logs

paranoid.name: Paranoid
paranoid.description: Maximum security with minimal permissions. Only essential commands allowed.

standard.name: Standard
standard.description: Balanced security with reasonable restrictions. Recommended for most users.

permissive.name: Permissive
permissive.description: Minimal restrictions with broad permissions. Use with caution.

allowlist.title: Command Allowlist
allowlist.description: Control which commands Auto-Claude can execute in allowlist
allowlist.empty: No commands in allowlist. Add commands to get started.
allowlist.noMatching: No commands match your allowlist search

addDialog.title: Add Command to Allowlist
addDialog.description: Add a new command to security allowlist. You can specify whether it's allowed by default in allowlist.
addDialog.allowedHint: If checked, command will be allowed in allowlist. If unchecked, it will be blocked unless explicitly allowed.

status.allowedHint: This command is currently allowed to execute
status.blockedHint: This command is currently blocked from executing in allowlist

removeDialog.title: Remove Command?
removeDialog.description: Are you sure you want to remove "{{command}}" from allowlist?
removeDialog.warningHint: The command will be removed from allowlist and revert to its default security behavior.

allowlist.tipDescription: Manage which commands Auto-Claude is allowed to execute. Blocked commands in allowlist will be prevented from running for security.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.searchPlaceholder: Search by message, command, file path...

warnings.permissiveLevel: Switching to Permissive mode will allow broad system access. This may expose your system to security risks. Continue?
warnings.riskyConfigDescription: Your current security settings allow broad access to system resources. Consider switching to Standard or Paranoid mode for better security.
warnings.paranoidEnabled: Paranoid security level enabled - only essential commands are allowed
warnings.paranoidDisabled: Paranoid security level disabled - returning to standard security settings

toast.logsRefreshedDescription: Security event logs have been updated
